question: The average age of 40 students of a class is 12 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 13 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Increase in average age = 13 − 12 = 1 year.

Number of students originally = 40.

Teacher's age = New Average + (Initial Number of Students × Increase in Average)

Teacher's age = 13 + (40 × 1) = 53 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 53.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of 40 students = 12 years.

Average age of 41 people (40 students + 1 teacher) = 13 years.

**Formula Used:**

Total Age = Average Age × Number of People

 
 40 Students (Avg: 12)
 
 Teacher
 
• 
 Combined Average: 13 years
 

 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 40 students = 40 × 12 = 480 years.

⇒ Total age of 41 people = 41 × 13 = 533 years.

⇒ Age of the teacher = (Total age of 41 people) − (Total age of 40 students)

⇒ Age of the teacher = 533 − 480

⇒ Age of the teacher = 53 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 53.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

New Member Age Formula

When a person joins a group, their age = New Average + (Old Number of Members × Change in Average).

Leaving Member Age Formula

When a person leaves a group, their age = Old Average + (New Number of Members × Change in Average).

Weighted Average

Combined Average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is count and x is the individual average.</p
